verdict.rationale: Glama's core product is an MCP registry. Its docs describe searching a curated catalog of open-source servers and remote connectors, inspecting their capabilities, and browsing /mcp/servers. The llms.txt probe shows a directory of 91,626 servers and 23,749 connectors, and a directory API lists servers programmatically. A community user describes the sea of servers on the Glama site, which confirms the catalog is large. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of filtering or faceting search results by capability, rather than inspecting capabilities per server.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent
